impact: A broad relief rally that lifts every AI holding (MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, GOOGL, MSFT, PLTR) off correction lows. One day does not end the correction; the Dec 9 Fed decision, with a hike widely priced, is the next test.
summary: Stocks rebounded sharply on Monday after the worst week in more than six years for the Nasdaq and Dow had left all three averages in a correction. The Dow added 1,447.98 points (3.01%) to 49,595.31, the S&P 500 rose 4.73% to 7,237.17 and the Nasdaq jumped 6.51% to 24,089.56. Tech led and energy lagged as the VIX fell.
title: Dow soars 1,448 points, Nasdaq +6.5% in best day since April 2025 on Huang return
